Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified World War I as the conflict with over 60 million casualties. The WebSurfer correctly found information that the Livesey Hall War Memorial commemorates both World War I and World War II. However, the Planner inaccurately associated the 60 million casualties with World War I, when in fact, World War II is the conflict typically associated with over 60 million casualties. This misassociation led to the incorrect conclusion that World War I was the answer, when it should have been World War II.
